newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing North Star to offer 614.8 mln shrs in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Beijing North Star to offer 614.8 mln shrs in IPO.

text.p: Chinese property development and investment concern Beijing North Star Co Ltd said on Monday it is issuing 614.8 million H-shares at HK$2.40 each in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong.
The company said the issue would raise about HK$1.48 billion.
The issue price represents a prospective price/earnings multiple of about 13.5 times on a fully diluted basis and 12.7 times on a weighted average basis.
North Star, the property arm of China's Beijing municipal government, said the issue accounted for about 34.6 percent of the company's enlarged share capital.
Underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option to require the company to issue a maximum of 92.22 million additional shares, accounting for 15 percent of the H-share offer.

Among the issue, 351.48 million shares will be placed with professional and institutional investors in an international offering and 171.10 million shares will be offered to a subsidiary of the New World Group, Rich Funds Ltd.
The New World Group will hold a 9.6 percent stake in the company after the offer, it said.
The remaining 92.22 million shares are for public subscription in Hong Kong.
The IPO will run from May 6-9 and dealing in the company's shares is expected to begin on May 14.

Of net proceeds of about 1.5 billion yuan, the company plans to use 805 million yuan to develop projects and buy land, 200 million yuan to repay loans, 160 million to improve existing projects, and the rest for working capital.
The company forecasts profit after tax and minority interests but before extraordinary items of not less than 315 million yuan for the year ending December 31, 1997.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia is the sponsor and global coordinator of the issue.
